candidate_admission.active_liquid: exists native k with qc>1e-15 and rho_dry*nc>ncmin(xland), ncmin_land=10 and ncmin_sea=10 from the exact C2 namelist.
candidate_admission.coefficient_domain_gate: For each strict active-liquid profile, build the same native39 plus declared RTTOV profile004 above-model-top reference background (24 extra layers, same pressure extension/interpolation; source-backed REAL(4) P8W reconstruction retained). Use only the exact currently installed GKOMPSAT-2/AMI coefficient file and active RTTOV options.
candidate_admission.frame_order: chronological retained C2 frames (20s then 40s); use earliest frame with any eligible candidate
candidate_admission.selection_after_gate: Within earliest frame having candidates that pass strict active-liquid, sea/IREMIS surface, and all coefficient-support gates, sort by sequential-f64 sum(qc) ascending, tie by global row-major (j,i), and choose median index N//2. Selection uses input arrays only; no BT/FD/K/ReturnQuality/output is used.
candidate_admission.strict_state_support: all39-level strict exact moment pairs qc/nc, qr/nr, qi/ni, qg/bg; finite state/forcing and original frame-reader numerical preconditions; no synthesized or clipped state.

surface_scope.meaning: sea/IREMIS case only; land and sea-ice columns are excluded from candidate eligibility and their counts must be reported separately.

exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.active_gases: T and Q are always screened. The exact run has nonempty f_o3=/atm/o3.txt and f_co2=/atm/co2.txt; rttov_test.F90 sets rt_all%o3_data/co2_data true when those paths are nonempty. The installed coefficient carries Mixed_gases, Water_vapour, Ozone, WV_Continuum, and CO2; check only gas profiles actually passed/active under the exact test options, and use coefficient/background convention for fixed gases.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.checked_layer_range: Use exact `rttov_check_reg_limits` lay_upper:lay_lower range for each input profile, including its coefficient-top extrapolation exclusion and lower-surface bound. Do not check extrapolated top coefficient levels that source excludes.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.failure_policy: Fail/reject the candidate; do not clamp/humidity-adjust, disable apply_reg_limits, omit active-gas checks, change coefficient, or hide/clear quality flags.

limit_scales.gases: rttov_init_coef applies env_prfl_gmax*(1+gscale_def) and env_prfl_gmin*(1-gscale_def), gscale_def=0.2
limit_scales.temperature: rttov_init_coef applies env_prfl_tmax*(1+tscale_def) and env_prfl_tmin*(1-tscale_def), tscale_def=0.1

exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.limit_source: Coefficient PROFILE_ENVELOPE pressure-dependent values loaded by rttov_read_ascii_coef.F90; v13 profile-level gas limits are averaged to coefficient layers before these default scales.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.limits: Compare coefficient-layer T/Q/O3/CO2 to the exact pressure-dependent `lim_prfl_tmin/tmax` and `lim_prfl_gmin/gmax` arrays loaded by RTTOV from the coefficient `PROFILE_ENVELOPE` and initialized/scaled by RTTOV source. Accept values equal to a bound; reject any checked value strictly below min or strictly above max, matching source predicates.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.profile_interpolation: Use actual coefficient pressure-half vector from the selected coefficient file; compute coefficient full/center pressures by `rttov_calc_p_full` arithmetic mean of adjacent half levels. Use `enable_interp=.TRUE.`, `interp_mode=4`; `rttov_intavg_prof` maps modes other than explicit mode2 to Rochon. Run the source-defined `rttov_layeravg` weights in ln(P) for every profile variable.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.unit_conversion: For each user layer with moist-basis q, compute factor = 1/(1 - Q_moist*1e-6) per rttov_convert_profile_units.F90. Apply Q_dry = Q_moist*factor and the SAME layer factor to every enabled moist-ppmv trace-gas profile (O3 and CO2) before coefficient-layer averaging and bound checks.
exact_rttov_coefficient_support_test.user_profile_units: input Q in ppmv over moist air (`run_gas_units=2`); `rttov_convert_profile_units` maps to ppmv dry by q_dry=q_moist/(1-q_moist*1e-6). T is K.

not_screened_by_this_input_gate.delta_eddington_bit15: This gate cannot certify its absence. The installed source sets it when any Eddington extinction cell exceeds 20; total extinction includes both clear-sky path extinction and hydrometeor extinction. No layer-resolved extinction diagnostics are exposed in the current no-diagnostic RT input path.
not_screened_by_this_input_gate.historical_c5: Do not rewrite previous frozen selection; this is a new rule for any future census only.
not_screened_by_this_input_gate.return_quality: Always retain and report RTTOV ReturnQuality unchanged from any authorized later run; nonzero bit0 or bit15 stays explicit. The current retry produced raw [32769,32769,1,1,1,1,1,1,1].

parent_approval_state: Frozen input-only rule for subsequent census; no new candidate selection or BT/K output has used it.

red_review_correction.action: Explicitly included same per-layer factor before all trace-gas coefficient-layer interpolation.
red_review_correction.finding: Moist-to-dry factor applies to O3 and CO2 as well as Q under gas_units=2.

scope: Input-only screen for the conditional C5 native 5-km liquid-profile search. It does not certify zero RTTOV ReturnQuality, physical S2 number calibration, D-Eddington support, or observation agreement.

supersedes_rule.reason: Freeze C5’s explicit sea/IREMIS observation scope before any coefficient-domain census or subsequent candidate selection.
